title.rendered: Arrow Formal Shirt for Men Filafil Shirt 100% Cotton

content.rendered:
The Arrow Formal Shirt for Men is a perfect blend of sophistication and everyday comfort. Designed using premium Filafil 100% cotton fabric, this shirt delivers a crisp and polished appearance ideal for formal occasions, corporate meetings, or smart office wear. Known for its fine texture and superior breathability, the Filafil shirt ensures that you look sharp and stay cool throughout the day.

Premium 100% Cotton Filafil Fabric Crafted from 100% cotton, the Arrow Filafil shirt provides unmatched softness and durability. The Filafil weave gives it a subtle texture and sheen, making it stand out among regular formal shirts. Whether you’re attending business events or dressing for success at work, this Arrow formal cotton shirt adds elegance and confidence to your look.Comfort Meets StyleArrow’s craftsmanship guarantees precision in every stitch. The shirt features a modern fit that complements all body types, ensuring both style and comfort. Its smooth cotton fabric offers superior moisture absorption, making it a favorite choice for men’s office wear in all seasons. Pair it with tailored trousers or chinos for a complete, classy appearance.

Key Features of Arrow Filafil Shirt

  • Material: 100% Filafil Cotton – breathable and soft
  • Fit: Regular/Modern Fit for all-day comfort
  • Collar: Classic spread collar for a professional look
  • Durable stitching and long-lasting color retention
  • Perfect for business meetings, formal gatherings, and office wear

Why Choose Arrow Formal Shirts?

With decades of excellence, Arrow is a trusted brand in men’s fashion, known for its timeless quality and impeccable tailoring. The Arrow formal shirt for men offers a premium feel, elegant design, and fine detailing that never goes out of style. Ideal for those who value sophistication, this shirt ensures you always look your best at work or after-hours events.
